_comment: Canonical typed wire models for the public spectator feed protocol. The Gateway outbound publisher signs and sends append-only batches to a hosted mirror's authenticated ingest endpoint. Public browsers connect to the mirror's anonymous read-only endpoints (bootstrap, cursor-paginated history, replayable SSE, content-addressed proof downloads). The private Gateway receives no public connection. All models exclude null fields on the wire.

public_feed_protocol_version._description: The public observer feed protocol version. Bumped when the batch, snapshot, or proof schema changes in a backward-incompatible way.

public_feed_record._description: One record in a signed batch. A record is a serialized projection or event payload with its SHA-256 content hash. The record type identifies whether it is a live projection, an event payload, a proof manifest, or a key revocation record.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number assigned by the source

record_type.description: Record type from the closed vocabulary

record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical record bytes (64-char hex)

record_bytes.description: Canonical JSON bytes of the record, UTF-8 encoded

public_feed_batch._description: A signed append-only batch binding source, protocol version, schema version, monotonic sequence range, prior-batch hash, record hashes, generated time, content hash, signing key ID, and Ed25519 signature. The first batch carries a fixed zero hash for previous_batch_hash. The mirror rejects any batch whose first sequence is less than or equal to the last accepted sequence.

source_id.description: Pseudonymous source deployment identifier. Not the real hostname, IP, or PKI identity.

first_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number of the first record in the batch

last_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number of the last record in the batch

previous_batch_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous accepted batch. The first batch carries a fixed zero hash (64-char hex of 32 zero bytes).

record_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each record in the batch, in order

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the batch was produced

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical encoding of all record hashes and batch metadata (64-char hex)

signing_key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key used to produce the signature

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the content hash, hex-encoded

records.description: Records in this batch, in sequence order

public_feed_snapshot._description: A snapshot binding the high-water sequence (the last accepted sequence) and the feed-chain hash (the content hash of the last accepted batch). A public client reconciles against the snapshot to establish a consistent cursor.

high_water_sequence.description: The last accepted monotonic sequence number

feed_chain_hash.description: Content hash of the last accepted batch (64-char hex)

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the snapshot was produced

public_feed_bootstrap._description: One bounded initial snapshot for public first paint. Contains the feed snapshot, current source freshness, recent projections, and proof catalog summary. SSE provides incremental change notifications after the snapshot.

snapshot.description: Current feed snapshot with high-water sequence and feed-chain hash

recent_projections.description: Bounded list of recent public projections (JSON objects). Each carries only allowlisted fields.

proof_catalog_summary.description: Summary of the available public proof packages

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the bootstrap was produced

public_feed_cursor_page._description: Cursor-paginated page of public records (projections, events, or proof manifests). Uses stable cursors and bounded page sizes (1-100, default 20). Anonymous reads are bounded by the rate policy.

items.description: Page items. Each item is a JSON object with only allowlisted fields.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

limit.description: Page size applied to this response

public_ingest_request._description: Authenticated ingest request from the Gateway outbound publisher to the hosted mirror. Carries the signed batch. The mirror verifies the signature, checks the sequence range against the high-water mark, validates the prior-batch hash chain, and accepts or rejects idempotently.

batch.description: The signed append-only batch to ingest

public_ingest_response._description: Authenticated ingest response from the mirror. Carries the accepted flag, the updated high-water sequence, and the updated feed-chain hash. A rejected batch carries a typed rejection reason.

accepted.description: Whether the mirror accepted the batch

high_water_sequence.description: Updated high-water sequence after acceptance. Omitted when rejected.

feed_chain_hash.description: Updated feed-chain hash after acceptance. Omitted when rejected.

rejection_reason.description: Typed rejection reason when accepted is false

public_key_revocation_record._description: A key revocation record published as a signed batch record before the old key is deactivated. Carries the revoked key ID, revocation time, and revocation signature from the new key.

revoked_key_id.description: Identifier of the revoked signing key

revoked_at.description: UTC timestamp when the revocation was issued

new_key_id.description: Identifier of the replacement signing key

revocation_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the revocation record from the new key, hex-encoded

public_proof_manifest._description: Root manifest for a public proof package. Binds the proof root SHA-256, campaign identity, verified index generation hash, artifact count, artifact catalog, verifier instructions, and generation time. A network-disabled verifier reproduces the root from the manifest and the listed artifacts.

proof_root_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical encoding of all artifact hashes and manifest metadata (64-char hex)

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

campaign_revision.description: Campaign revision from the frozen profile hash

verified_index_generation_hash.description: SHA-256 of the verified index generation's content hash (64-char hex)

verification_ok.description: True when the campaign verification report passed

artifact_count.description: Number of artifacts in the proof package

artifacts.description: Catalog entries for every artifact in the proof package

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the proof package was generated

signing_key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key used to sign the proof root

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the proof root SHA-256, hex-encoded

public_proof_catalog_entry._description: One entry in the public proof catalog. Each artifact is served under an immutable content-addressed identity derived from its SHA-256. Catalog metadata includes filename, media type, bytes, SHA-256, signature and trust metadata, campaign and run source, generated time, classification, verification command, and immutable URL.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the artifact content

byte_size.description: Byte length of the artifact content

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact content (64-char hex)

campaign_id.description: Campaign identity from the campaign manifest

source_run_id.description: Source eval run identity. Omitted for campaign-level artifacts.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the artifact was generated

verification_command.description: Offline verification command for this artifact

immutable_url.description: Immutable content-addressed URL path relative to the mirror base URL

public_proof_catalog._description: The full public proof catalog listing every available proof package artifact. Served as a bounded anonymous read. Public retention uses append-only tombstones rather than rewriting history.

entries.description: Catalog entries for every available proof artifact

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the catalog was generated

public_proof_catalog_summary._description: Summary of the public proof catalog for bootstrap responses. Carries the total artifact count, total byte size, and the most recent generation time.

artifact_count.description: Total number of proof artifacts in the catalog

total_byte_size.description: Total byte size of all proof artifacts

last_generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recently generated proof artifact. Omitted when the catalog is empty.

public_export_config._description: Owner-only export configuration for the outbound publisher. Carries the allowlisted HTTPS origin, signing key ID, pseudonymous source ID, batch size limit, and retry policy. Secrets never appear in frontend runtime JSON, logs, events, reports, proofs, or contract packs. The private key is stored in the Gateway runtime tree, not in this configuration.

enabled.description: Whether the outbound publisher is enabled

mirror_origin.description: Allowlisted HTTPS origin for the hosted mirror ingest endpoint

signing_key_id.description: Identifier of the active signing key

batch_max_records.description: Maximum number of records per batch

retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum retry attempts for a failed batch transmission

ack_confirmation_window_seconds.description: Seconds to retain acknowledged batches before removal from the outbox

public_outbox_entry._description: One entry in the durable ordered outbox. The outbound publisher writes each batch to the outbox before network transmission. Acknowledged batches are removed after the confirmation window. The outbox survives process restarts and mirror outages.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number of the first record in the batch

batch_hash.description: Content hash of the batch (64-char hex)

batch_bytes.description: Canonical JSON bytes of the signed batch, UTF-8 encoded

last_attempt_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last transmission attempt. Omitted when no attempt has been made.

acknowledged_at.description: UTC timestamp when the mirror acknowledged the batch. Omitted when not acknowledged.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the outbox entry was created
